title: Little Crafting Tweaks
description: just a datapack that adds some QOL recipes to minecraft
body:
this datapack adds a couple of somewhat balanced crafting recipes that helps imporve the QOL of minecraft.

## Recipies
- Bundle: Leather and string
- Name Tag: Paper, Black Dye, String and an Iron Ingot
- Powered Rails (6): Copper instead of gold (doesn't remove original recipe)
- Saddle: 3 Leather and an Iron Ingot
- Rabbit Hide: Smelting Rotten Flesh
- Red Sand (8): 8 Sand and Red Dye
- Sand (8): 8 Red Sand and Water Bucket
- Dragon's Breath (2): Dragon's Breath, 6 Diamonds, Purpur Block and a Glass Bottle
- String (9): Cobweb
- String (4): Wool
